storage: One externally supplied ClickHouse HTTP endpoint with embedded Keeper; synthetic isolated database
subject: Supported external ClickHouse topology and fail-closed startup

supported.clickhouse: One ClickHouse server with KeeperMap and durable local tables, addressed by a stable endpoint
supported.lens: Multiple Lens API/runtime processes sharing that same database and credentials
unsupported: Requests distributed across multiple ClickHouse servers
Distributed or replicated payload table substitution
Automatic failover to a different ClickHouse server
supported.reason: The KeeperMap head is coordinated but record payloads and indexes use local ReplacingMergeTree storage

diagnostics.preflight: Startup initializes trace/state tables and publishes the service worker before binding HTTP
diagnostics.missing_keeper: The unconfigured ClickHouse fixture exited with StateStorage(StateFailed { status: 400, code: Some(36) })
diagnostics.insufficient_permissions: The SELECT-only database user exited with Storage(Storage(SchemaFailed(403)))
diagnostics.limitation: Diagnostics currently expose a storage error or ClickHouse status/code; operators must consult the ClickHouse logs for the detailed rejected statement or capability

limitations: The two-process run checks shared sessions, dataset persistence, logout and restart; the separate writer-lease suite checks competing reservations, progress, fencing and cleanup
No multi-node ClickHouse, managed service compatibility, automatic storage failover or production capacity claim
